Movement along Broad Street down to Apongbon, underneath the bridge connecting Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, remains steady. Traffic on Eko Bridge inward Apongbon, linking CMS Bridge, Elegbeta, and CFAO, is also in good condition.

Descending Idumota Bridge inward Ebute-Ero Market, through Leventist and UBA Roundabout to connect both Inner and Outer Marina, is equally moving well.

At present, no impediments have been reported, and personnel are visibly on ground managing the situation effectively.

[4:41PM] #VictoriaIsland #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic from McWen Bridge inward Bonny Camp Roundabout is currently steady. The return journey from Bonny Camp toward McWen Bridge is busy but moving, largely due to the evening rush.

Movement along Ahmadu Bello Way, both inward and outward, remains good, with only slight delays around Adeola Odeku Junction caused by alternations and traffic signal delays. Traffic inward Eko Hotel Roundabout is slow, attributed to heavy vehicular influx and signal light delays, while the return journey remains smooth.

Vehicular movement from Bonny Camp Underpass en route Kofo Abayomi is clear, while inward Oniru Kilimanjaro is busy but moving, also impacted by the close-hour rush and traffic alternations. The stretch from Law School to Civic Center is experiencing slow movement due to heavy traffic and light delays.

Traffic inward from BJ 1004 to School Corner, through Sandfield to Lekki Phase 1, is generally steady except for delays at alternation points and traffic lights. Lekki Phase 1 to Sandfield is busy but moving, while BJ 1004 to Civic Center is steady. Civic Center inward Ramp Bridge is also busy but moving, with the rush hour and signal delays contributing to the situation. Similarly, traffic from Civic to Law School and Law School to Akin Adesola moves steadily but experiences minor delays due to alternations and traffic signals.

Inward Kilimanjaro is moving with heavy influx and some alternation delays, while Kilimanjaro to Kofo inward Bonny Camp Roundabout en route Mekwen Bridge is slow-moving due to evening rush and alternation under Bonny Camp Bridge.

At present, only slight delays are being observed at alternation points. No major impediments have been sighted. Our officers are on ground and effectively managing the situation. 

#FollowLASTMA
